source_verification_receipts.locator: Section 4.4, Theorems 4.6–4.7, equations (16)–(19); Appendix F, Lemma F.6, equation (78)
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Theorem 4.6 gives the logarithmically suppressed upper rate and Theorem 4.7 gives an up-to-logarithms lower bound for any non-anticipating experiment and unbiased estimator pair. The Cauchy-projection identity is Lemma F.6 in Appendix F, assumes local unbiasedness, and explicitly substitutes E_P[T]=θ(P).
For univariate random-design heteroscedastic regression with mean smoothness α and variance smoothness β, the global squared-risk order is n^{-8αβ/(4αβ+2α+β)} ∨ n^{-2β/(2β+1)}.
The paper establishes minimax convergence theory for multivariate variance-function estimation in the iid Gaussian fixed-design setting.
The paper gives a constrained-risk inequality for general non-decreasing losses and explicitly identifies super-efficient and adaptive estimators as applications.
